messages:
maria: Customer flagged embeddings usage chart showing units as 'tokens' but numbers look like vector counts and are ~3x their expectation. They say billing spike and UI labels don't match. Screenshot attached.

sam: Can you paste the org id and any example request payload?

maria: org-6789. Customer replayed a job: many small docs batched by their client. They sent a screenshot and sample request.

lee: Thx. Can you repro on staging with their batch size? Also need logs from metrics pipeline for those timestamps.

maria: Their quick repro steps: 1) POST /v1/embeddings with redwood-embed-large 2) send ~3000 inputs in batches of 128 3) check Console -> Usage -> Embeddings 4) compare to /v1/usage API. Example cURL:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large","input":["doc1","doc2", ...]}'
```

They say dashboard shows "units" as tokens but the value equals vector_count * batch_size for their job.

sam: I ran a quick check on metrics transforms. There are two counters emitted: embeddings.vectors and embeddings.tokens. The aggregation transform joins on request_id but in some replay cases request_id is null which causes vectors to be attributed to the last seen batch size tag. Could produce apparent multiplication.

dave: Customer is on a paid plan and got a big invoice. We need a mitigation ASAP: either hide the incorrect metric on the UI or add a warning. Also need an estimated credit.

lee: I replayed the kafka topic for metrics around those offsets and observed duplicate events for partition 3 (offsets 124500-124620) — looks like the producer retries emitted events without idempotent keys. The transform uses batch_size tag to normalize tokens -> vectors but if the event lacks request_id the join multiplies by batch_size.

infra-bot: Scheduled deploy to metrics-transformer service at 2045679900 to add idempotency check and null-request_id guard.

sam: Local repro command for engineering: `python tools/repro_embed_counts.py --org org-6789 --batch-size 128 --replay=true` produced a UI-like dump showing 2.9x counts compared to baseline.

lee: Root cause summary: analytics transform incorrectly maps unit_type -> multiplier when request_id is missing; replayed/retied messages without request_id cause double counting by re-applying batch multiplier. Fix: ensure request_id required for join, fallback to per-message vector_count when missing, add unit tests and an idempotency key at producer.

dave: For customer remediation: propose UI patch to label units explicitly and temporary credit equal to estimated overcharge (waiting on finance calc). I'll draft email.

maria: I'll reply to customer with short explanation, ETA ~4h for mitigation deploy, and reference INC-2045. :thumbsup:

sre-ops-bot: Incident INC-2045 created and on-call alerted.

maria: Adding follow-up: collect the raw events (we asked customer to enable verbose logging) and we will run the replay with stricter dedupe. Will update thread in 2h.
